text:
Maria: Quick sync — were lining up a community workshop + 30-min webinar to launch the OSS refapp. Target week: June 7-11. Goal: hands-on tutorial, short benchmark story, and a clear inbound routing path for signups.

Alex: Im in. Live webinar for Q&A + a 10-12min recorded product demo we can embed for other timezones?

Samir: Live preferred. I can own the webinar script and the customer-facing examples (search, summarization, live chat ops).

Jin: Ill add a lightweight perf job to the refapp CI. Output: median latency, p95/p99, and cost-per-1k-tokens for the sample workload. ETA: Wed.

Olivia: Design can produce a hero banner + 2 social thumbnails. Need the staging demo URL and 3 screenshots.

Alex: For the tutorial Ill draft a 5-step quickstart: install, run locally, deploy to staging, enable caching/batching, view metrics. Will include short code snippets.

Maria: Routing requirement: form submissions -> Intercom + calendar invite; tag leads with "oss-refapp-june"; auto-notify SDRs via Slack. Samir, confirm required form fields?

Samir: Required: company, work email, role, expected monthly inference volume, primary cloud. Optional: compliance/regulatory checkbox. Also ask whether they want a Dedicated demo.

Olivia: CTAs for blog: 1) Try the live demo, 2) Clone tutorial repo, 3) Register for webinar. Link anchor to benchmark section.

Alex: Include a minimal code example in the blog showing quick start, something like:
```
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
print(client.generate('Summarize this repo in one sentence'))
```
Keep it tiny.

Jin: CI benchmark will produce a JSON artifact plus a small markdown table in the repo. Ill add a reproducibility blurb and the exact command: 
``
make ci-benchmark SAMPLE_PROMPTS=prompts/customer_support.json
```
And note the machine spec and model variant.

Maria: Presenters: Alex (demo), Samir (product + use-cases), Jin (ops/benchmarks). Olivia will handle slides and visuals.

Alex: Ill rehearse with Jin on the demo perf so we dont hit surprising spikes. Can someone stash demo creds in 1Password?

deploy-bot: :rocket: Staging demo deployed at https://staging-refapp.redwood.example — creds in 1Password under "refapp-staging-demo".

Olivia: Design timeline: hero + thumbnails by May 28, slides by June 4. Ill deliver 3 variants (static, animated gif, and social crop).

Samir: For the benchmark narrative, lets highlight how caching and batching impact unit cost. Include an A/B showing no-cache vs cache warm. Also show fallback to a cheaper quantized model and its cost/latency tradeoff.

Alex: Ill add a short troubleshooting FAQ in the tutorial repo (KV cache warmup, model fallback behavior, auth errors).

Jin: Also adding a small script to simulate burst traffic and measure tail latency. Itll live in tools/perf and be runnable like: `python tools/perf/run_burst.py --prompts prompts/scale.json`.

Maria: Ops deadlines: draft blog + tutorial by May 24, design assets by May 28, webinar page & form live June 1, rehearsals June 5, webinar June 9. Does that timeline look doable?

Olivia: Works for design.

Alex: Works on my side; will tag any blockers early.

Samir: Ill prepare the webinar slide deck and the three customer stories by May 26.

Maria: Great. Ill create a brief launch checklist and a calendar for rehearsals. Posting a follow-up with the draft blog outline in this thread tomorrow. :thumbsup:
